description: HDR is a 100% employee-owned (ESOP) global professional services firm providing engineering, architecture, environmental, and construction services. Founded in 1917, the firm operates 200+ offices across 15 countries with 14,200+ employees, generating annual revenue approaching $4 billion. HDR specializes in transportation, water, energy, aviation, and advanced manufacturing sectors, leveraging integrated multidisciplinary expertise and technology integration to solve complex infrastructure challenges for public and private clients.
business_model: 100% employee-owned professional services firm (ESOP) delivering project-based engineering, architecture, environmental, and construction services globally. Revenue generated through professional services contracts with public agencies and private sector clients.
pricing_model: Project-based professional services fees (time & materials, lump sum, cost-plus)
financial_highlights: South Carolina DOT FY25 professional services contracts: $4,981,981.50
South Carolina DOT annual report shows HDR Engineering Inc. at $16,982,836.10 in professional services
Employee ownership model established via 1996 buyback from French conglomerate
value_proposition: Employee ownership (ESOP) aligns incentives with long-term client success, fostering accountability and partnership culture. Integrated multidisciplinary expertise across transportation, water, energy, aviation, and advanced manufacturing enhanced by technology integration for improved productivity and project delivery. Global reach with local presence in 200+ offices.
